headline: Budget committee approves housing changes, discusses Kīhei property purchase

meeting.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meeting.voteItem: Increase a homeowner and housing counseling program by $165,000
meeting.summary: Members added $165,000 for a homeowner and housing counseling program, one unfunded housing specialist position, and earlier fee waivers to rates and fees, each with nine ayes. A member moved to lower the Cove Beach Village amount to $2.5 million.
meeting.recap: The committee worked through housing items in the proposed budget.[[0:09:25]] Members approved adding $165,000 to a homeowner and housing counseling program, with nine ayes.[[0:10:11]] The council chair withdrew a $4 million proposal for a Lahaina long-term recovery group, saying another member is proposing $1 million.[[0:11:12]] Members approved one new housing specialist position, with no funding attached, for a long-term housing program, with nine ayes.[[0:13:54]] A county director said a recently passed fee waiver ordinance was not in the fiscal year 27 budget.[[0:18:21]] A proposal sought up to $8.62 million in bond funds to buy Cove Beach Village, a 32-unit site in Kīhei.[[0:19:47]] A county director said the land is valued at about $2.5 million.[[0:23:50]] A county official said a higher negotiated price would come back to the council for approval.[[0:31:29]] A member moved to lower the amount to $2.5 million.[[0:37:01]] Members approved adding fee waivers from an earlier ordinance to the budget's rates and fees, with nine ayes.[[0:47:02]]
decided: Members approved adding $165,000 to a homeowner and housing counseling program.
The council chair withdrew a $4 million proposal for a Lahaina long-term recovery group.
Members approved adding fee waivers from an earlier ordinance into Appendix B, rates and fees.
meeting.next: Members planned to take up liquor, transportation, planning and other departments that night.

moments.q: "The cost of homes, this $30,000 is just not cutting it."
"It's rare to have an opportunity to buy prime land that's fully entitled."
"You don't go to a car dealership and pay the first thing that they say."
